characteristics.name: Squadron Ability
characteristics.$text: After your activation, if you were activated by a Squad command, choose up to 2 non-unique squadrons at distance 1 of you. The chosen squadrons may activate as if they were activated by that squadron command.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: "MC" only.  [Repair]:  You may choose and exhaust another copy of this card on a friendly ship at distance 1-4.  If you do, you gain 2 additional engineering points.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: Before an enemy ship is dealt a faceup damage card, look at the top 4 cards of the damage deck, place 1 on top of the deck, and discard the others.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: After deploying fleets, place 2 non-consecutive round tokens on this card.  At the start of the Ship Phase during each round matching 1 of those tokens, each friendly ship may gain a number of command tokens equal to its command value.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship resolves the [Evade] token effect, it can cancel 1 die at medium range or reroll 1 additional die at close range or distance 1.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: Before a friendly ship's Attack step, it may choose to attack from only its left and right hull zones this round.  If it does, it may add 2 red dice to its attack pool while attacking a ship.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, when a friendly ship or friendly unique squadron is destroyed, it remains in the play area and is treated as if it was not destroyed until the end of the Status Phase.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly small or medium ship is defending against a ship, if the defender is at speed 3 or higher, the attack is treated as obstructed.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly ship is executing its first maneuver during its activation, during the Determine Course step, it may increase 1 yaw value by 1.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly ship is attacking a ship at distance 1 of friendly squadron, before rolling attack dice, the attacker may replace up to 2 dice in its attack pool with an equal number of dice of any color or colors.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship resolves a command by spending a command dial, if it has not resolved another command this round, it may resolve that command as if it also spent a matching command token.  If it does, that ship cannot resolve additional commands this round.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: Before deploying fleets, you may set aside 1 other friendly ship with a command value of 3 or less.  At the start of any round, you may deploy that ship at distance 1-2 of you.  That ship cannot be deployed overlapping squadrons and cannot be the first ship to activate that round.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text:
After you deploy, gain 1 non-[Scatter] defense token.
During your Spend Defense Tokens step, if your speed is not 0, you may discard 1 defense token to resolve the effect of that defense token.  You cannot resolve the effect of each type of defense token more than once per attack.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text:
At the end of each Command Phase, you may look at all command dials assigned to 1 enemy ship. Then you may place 2 command tokens, each of a different type, on this card. 
After an enemy ship resolves a command, you may discard a matching command token from this card. If you do, that enemy ships gains 1 matching raid token.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending, you may exhaust this card to spend 1 defense token that your opponent targeted with an [Accuracy] result.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: When you resolve the [Redirect] token effect, you can choose more than 1 hull zone to suffer damage, which may include a nonadjacent hull zone.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
At the start of each Status Phase, you may recover 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: After a squadron performs an attack against you, even if you are destroyed, you may discard this card to roll 4 blue dice.  That squadron suffers 1 damage for each [Hit] or [Crit] icon rolled.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card to discard up to 3 of your facedown damage cards.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of each Ship Phase, you may choose 1 of your hull zones and mark it with a chaff token.  Until the end of the round, while a ship or squadron is attacking that hull zone, the attack is obstructed.  After the Status Phase, remove that chaff token.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending, you may exhaust this card and spend a readied defense token to resolve the [Salvo] defense effect instead of that token's effect.  You cannot resolve the [Salvo] defense effect more than once per attack.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text:
While a friendly squadron with Bomber at distance 1-5 is attacking a ship, it may reroll 1 die.  
A squadron cannot resolve more than 1 "Bomber Command Center" card per attack.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you may exhaust this card to choose an enemy ship at distance 1 - 3. Look at the top command dial assigned to that ship. Then you may either choose a new command on its top command dial or that ship gains 1 raid token of your choice that does not match its top command dial. If the chosen ship has no top command dial, it gains 1 raid token of your choice.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may discard 1 command token from this ship to assign a matching token to another friendly ship at distance 1-5.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: While a squadron at distance 1-2 is attacking a squadron or defending against a squadron, the attack must be treated as obstructed.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  Instead of spending engineering points, you may discard 1 damage card from 1 friendly ship at distance 1-2.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may exhaust this card and discard any number of [concentrate fire] tokens from it to choose that many friendly ships at distance 1-5.  Assign each chosen ship a [concentrate fire] token.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may exhaust this card and discard any number of [Repair] tokens from it to choose that many friendly ships at distance 1-5.  Assign each chosen ship a [Repair] token.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Exhaust all of the defender's defense tokens.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Choose and discard 1 command token from the defender.  If the defender does not have any command tokens, the defending hull zone loses 1 shield instead.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, you may spend 1 blue die to reroll any number of dice in your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a ship, each of your unspent blue [Accuracy] icons adds 1 damage to the damage total.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Exhaust this card to force the defender to choose and discard 1 of its defense tokens.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your left and right hull zones are increased by 1 blue die.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Choose and exhaust 1 of the defender's upgrade cards.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [crit]:  Exhaust this card.  The defending hull zone and each adjacent hull zone loses 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text:
Non-huge ship only.
While defending at close range or distance 1, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, you may force the attacker to reroll 1 die of your choice.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Your squadron value is increased by 1.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron at close range, you may reroll your [Crit] icons.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.
When you activate, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 enemy ship of your size class or smaller at distance 1-5.  That ship must spend a [Navigate] token or reduce its speed by 1 to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending at distance 1, if the attacker is a squadron, you have counter 1.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: [Squadron]:  You can activate friendly squadrons at close-long range (instead of close-medium).

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Before deploying fleets, you may set aside a number of friendly squadrons up to your squadron value next to your ship card.
When you reveal a command, you may discard this card. If you do, place each squadron set aside with this card within distance 1 - 2 of you. Those squadrons cannot move during your activation.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Small or medium ship only.
When you activate, you may discard this card.  If you do, the blue dice in your battery armament can be used while attacking ships at close-long range until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Large ship only.  
When you overlap a ship of smaller size class (or are overlapped by a ship of a smaller size class), deal 1 fewer facedown damage cards to your ship.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.
Friendly Heavy squadrons at distance 1-2 prevent engaged squadrons from attacking ships.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Before deploying fleets, you may discard this card to place a number of proximity mine tokens equal to half your engineering value, rounded down. You may place these tokens anywhere in the play area beyond distance 5 of enemy ships (and distance 1 of each other).

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: When a non-unique squadron with Swarm at distance 1-5 is destroyed, you may discard this card.  If you do, you may set that squadron's hull points to "2" and place that squadron, unengaged, at distance 1 with its activation slider toggled to the activated side.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Medium or Large ship only.
Flagship only.
Modification.
You gain 1 [Fleet Command] icon in your upgrade bar.
You cannot spend a command token to resolve a [Fleet Command] card's effect.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Treat each die in your anti-squadron armament as black.
While performing a [Salvo] attack, the black dice in your battery armament can be used at medium range and the blue dice in your battery armament can be used at long range.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may spend 1 command token to change that command to a [Navigate] or [Repair] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may spend 1 command token to change that command to a [Concentrate Fire] or [Squadron] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may choose another friendly ship at distance 1-5 and change that ship's top command to your revealed  command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, after you roll your attack pool, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 defense token.  If that defense token is spent during this attack, discard that token.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: After you resolve a [Squadron] command, exhaust this card to toggle the activation slider of 1 squadron activated with that command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may gain 1 matching command token without spending the command dial.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may discard this card to gain 1 command token of your choice.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability

characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Repair] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, if you overlapped an obstacle, you may discard this card instead of resolving the effects of overlapping that obstacle.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may discard this card to discard your top command dial.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: During your activation, you can resolve your [Squadron] command after you execute a maneuver.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: During the activation of a friendly ship at distance 1-5, you may exhaust this card to discard 1 command token from that ship.  If you do, that ship may gain 1 command token of any type.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you suffer damage from an attack, you may exhaust this card to reduce the total damage by 1.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you resolve the [Contain] defense effect, you can prevent the attacker from resolving any critical effects.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card to choose 2 different command tokens and place them on 2 different ships.  Then your opponent chooses 2 different command tokens you did not choose and places them on 2 different ships.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron with Counter or Intel, add 1 die of any color to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, when you spend a [Redirect] defense token, you may reduce the total damage from the attack by 1 instead of resolving that token's effect.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text:
[Squadron]: You may choose 1 enemy ship at close range. That ship gains 1 raid token of your choice. 
While you are at distance 1-3 of an enemy ship, that ship can discard only 1 raid token of any type when it discards a command dial.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may discard this card to move 1 obstacle at distance 1-2 so that it is within distance 1-2 of its current location.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card to place 1 proximity mine token in the play area at distance 1-2 of an obstacle and beyond distance 3 of enemy ships.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text:
Red or Blue [Crit]:  You may exhaust this card to ready 1 of your exhausted defense tokens.  
You can resolve this critical effect during a Salvo attack.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before the end of the Squadron Phase, you may spend 1 [squadron] token to choose up to 3 friendly, non-unique squadrons without Strategic at distance 1-5.  Those squadrons gain Cloak until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: Black [Crit]:  Exhaust this card.  Each hull zone adjacent to the defending hull zone suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your front hull zone is increased by 2 black die.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: Black [Crit]:  Exhaust this card to deal 1 faceup damage card to the defender.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your left and right hull zones are increased by 1 black die.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron, you may spend 1 black die with a [Crit] icon to toggle its activation slider to the activated side.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking at close range, you may discard this card to add 2 black dice to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: Black [Crit]:  If the defender is a ship, choose 1 other ship or squadron at close range of the defender.  That ship or squadron suffers damage equal to half of the total number of black [Hit] icons in your attack pool, rounded up.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text:
Medium or large ship only.  
At the end of your Attack Step, you may exhaust this card and choose 1 of your hull zones.  Then, perform an attack from that hull zone with an anti-squadron armament of 1 black die, even if you have already attacked from that zone this round.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Navigate]: If you spent a [Navigate] Token, once during this maneuver, when you would change your speed, you may instead increase 1 yaw value by 1.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text:
[Navigate]:  After you execute a maneuver, you may exhaust this card to execute a speed-1 maneuver.
After you execute a maneuver, if you overlapped a ship, exhaust this card.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  You may spend up to 2 engineering points to move that many shields from your ship to a friendly ship at distance 1-5.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you are dealt a faceup damage card with the Crew trait, you may discard this card to discard that damage card.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you may select a number of unengaged friendly squadrons up to your squadron value at close-medium range.  Those squadrons may move up to distance 1.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  You may treat the maximum shield values of your right and left hull zones as increased by 1 when you recover or move shields to those zones.  If you do, the number of shields in each of those zones cannot exceed a maximum of "4".

characteristics.name: Title Ability

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You can ignore the effects of overlapping obstacles.  Your attacks cannot be obstructed.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you gain a command token, 1 friendly ship at distance 1-5 may gain that token instead.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You gain 1 additional [Fleet Command] icon in you upgrade bar.  You cannot equip this card if you have a [Fleet Command] icon in your upgrade bar.  You cannot spend a command token to resolve a [Fleet Command] card's effect.

characteristics.$text: While defending, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, you may discard a defense token to cancel 1 attack die.

characteristics.name: Title Ability

characteristics.$text: At the start of the first round, gain 1 [Contain] defense token.

characteristics.name: Title Ability

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: [Squadron]:  If you spent a [Squadron] token, you may activate 1 additional squadron.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a ship that has already activated this round, add 1 die of any color to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: While another friendly ship at distance 1-5 is attacking, it may change 1 die to a face with an [Accuracy] icon.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: [Squadron]:  Each squadron you activate may increase its speed to 4 until the end of its activation.  Squadrons that change speed in this wat cannot attack this activation.
